Dialysis.workload_definition: Completed hemodialysis sessions in the reporting unit.

Emergency C-section.workload_definition: Cesarean procedures explicitly classified as emergency.

Maternity / delivery.workload_definition: Delivery episodes for all explicitly reported delivery modes.

NICU.workload_definition: Neonatal intensive care admissions or cases in the named NICU.

Pediatric care.workload_definition: Pediatric medicine outpatient encounters, including recorded follow-ups.

Cardiac surgery.workload_definition: Cardiac operations performed in the reporting hospital.

Cardiology consultation.workload_definition: Cardiology outpatient encounters, including recorded follow-ups.

Burn care.workload_definition: Burn-specific emergency admissions or other explicitly identified burn encounters.

Orthopedic surgery.workload_definition: Orthopedic operations, with major, minor, elective and emergency scope retained.

Fracture care.workload_definition: Fracture encounters, with emergency, inpatient and outpatient scope retained.

Dental care.workload_definition: Dental outpatient encounters or registrations, including recorded follow-ups.

Oral surgery.workload_definition: Oral and maxillofacial surgery procedures, with major, minor and extraction scope retained.

Cataract surgery.workload_definition: Cataract operations performed at the named site.

Stroke care.workload_definition: Stroke-specific emergency admissions or other explicitly identified stroke encounters.

Chemotherapy.workload_definition: Chemotherapy administrations or treatment sessions in the named setting.

Trauma / emergency.workload_definition: Emergency or casualty encounters, with trauma-specific case counts kept as a separate scope.
